 "consegna": "Applica lo shader di lampeggio (`res://shaders/hit_flash.gdshader`) al nemico camminatore (`WalkerEnemy`) per mostrare un effetto visivo quando subisce un colpo.

1. Apri la scena `res://enemies/walker_enemy.tscn` e assegna allo `Sprite2D` del nemico uno `ShaderMaterial` che utilizza lo shader `res://shaders/hit_flash.gdshader`.

   "codice": "extends "res://htd/htd_test.gd"


func _run_tests() -> void:
	var enemy_scene := await instantiate_scene("res://enemies/walker_enemy.tscn")
	if not check("enemy_scene", enemy_scene != null, "La scena res://enemies/walker_enemy.tscn deve caricarsi senza errori"):
		return
	var sprite := find_by_name(enemy_scene, "Sprite2D") as Sprite2D
	if not check("sprite", sprite != null and sprite.material is ShaderMaterial, "Lo Sprite2D del nemico deve contenere uno ShaderMaterial"):
		return
	var mat := sprite.material as ShaderMaterial
	if not check("has_take_damage", has_function(enemy_scene, "take_damage"), "Lo script del nemico deve contenere la funzione take_damage()"):
		return
	enemy_scene.call("take_damage", 1)
	await wait_frames(1)
	var flash_start = float(mat.get_shader_parameter("flash_modifier"))
	check("flash_activated", flash_start >= 0.8, "Chiamando take_damage(), flash_modifier deve impostarsi a 1.0 (trovato %.2f)" % flash_start)
	await wait_seconds(0.3)
	var flash_end = float(mat.get_shader_parameter("flash_modifier"))
	check("flash_deactivated", flash_end <= 0.1, "Dopo l'animazione di 0.2s, flash_modifier deve tornare a 0.0 (trovato %.2f)" % flash_end)
"

    "percorso": "player/state_machine.gd",
    "contenuto": "class_name StateMachine
extends Node

@export var initial_state: State

var current_state: State
var states: Dictionary = {}


func _ready() -> void:
	await owner.ready
	for child in get_children():
		if child is State:
			states[child.name.to_lower()] = child
			child.transitioned.connect(_on_child_transitioned)

	if initial_state:
		initial_state.enter()
		current_state = initial_state


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if current_state:
		current_state.update(delta)


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if current_state:
		current_state.physics_update(delta)


func _on_child_transitioned(state: State, new_state_name: String) -> void:
	if state != current_state:
		return

	var new_state: State = states.get(new_state_name.to_lower())
	if not new_state:
		return

	if current_state:
		current_state.exit()

	new_state.enter()
	current_state = new_state

@export var death_particles_scene: PackedScene = preload("res://effects/enemy_explosion.tscn")

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_on_floor():
		velocity.y += gravity * delta

uniform vec4 line_color : source_color = vec4(1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
uniform float line_thickness : hint_range(0.0, 10.0) = 0.0;

void fragment() {
	vec4 color = texture(TEXTURE, UV);
	if (color.a == 0.0 && line_thickness > 0.0) {
		vec2 size = TEXTURE_PIXEL_SIZE * line_thickness;
		float alpha_up = texture(TEXTURE, UV + vec2(0.0, -size.y)).a;
		float alpha_down = texture(TEXTURE, UV + vec2(0.0, size.y)).a;
		float alpha_left = texture(TEXTURE, UV + vec2(-size.x, 0.0)).a;
		float alpha_right = texture(TEXTURE, UV + vec2(size.x, 0.0)).a;
		float max_neighbor = max(max(alpha_up, alpha_down), max(alpha_left, alpha_right));
		if (max_neighbor > 0.0) {
			COLOR = line_color;
		} else {
			COLOR = color;
		}
	} else {
		COLOR = color;
	}
}
